name: Marin
source:
Behind his perfect mask lies a dark past that he prefers to keep hidden. When he met Lena, Marin saw in her a reflection of himself during the most difficult times of his life.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3615870/Farewell_we_see_each_other_for_the_last_time/]Steam[/url]]

His zodiac sign is Gemini.
